title: Nutty Zesty Korean Kimchi Mandu Jjigae
description: A kid-friendly, nutty, and chewy Korean dish featuring parmesan cheese, with a sattvic twist. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat a robata grill or a regular grill to medium heat.
In a large pan, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium heat.
Add the garlic and ginger and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the gochujang and soy sauce and stir to combine.
Add the zucchini and carrots and cook for 3-4 minutes.
Add the kimchi and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, mix the brown sugar and 1 tablespoon of water to create a paste.
Add the brown sugar paste to the pan and stir to combine.
Place a mandu wrapper on a flat surface and spoon some of the kimchi mixture onto the center of the wrapper.
Add a sprinkle of parmesan cheese on top of the kimchi mixture.
Fold the wrapper over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
Brush the tops of the mandu with the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil and place them on the preheated grill or pan.
Cook the mandu for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
